article.title: Taxpayer's Charter.
article.content: The Board shall adopt and declare a Taxpayer's Charter and issue such orders, instructions, directions or guidelines to other income-tax authorities as it may deem fit for the administration of such Charter.
article.html:
119ATaxpayer's Charter.

Section 119A · Chapter XIII · A.—Appointment and control · page 560 of the Act

The Board shall adopt and declare a Taxpayer's Charter and issue such orders, instructions, directions or guidelines to other income-tax authorities as it may deem fit for the administration of such Charter.
